tenderSchedule.description: Annual Maintenance and Repair Works of Borewells Located in Ward Nos. 01 to 10 and Ward Nos. 14 to 18 under Kunigal Town Municipal Council Limits- (Package-01)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate-Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, achieved in at least two financial years a Average annual financial turnover of Rs 20.00 Lakhs.

Bidder Should submit valid 1 No Own Vehicle and 1 No Hire Vehicle -Proper Agreement- 1 No. Own and 1 No. Hire Motor Maintenance Lifting Arrangements Mounted Vehicle with RTO Registration and Insurance copy, Emission test and Fitness Documents.
Bidder Should submit valid Electrical wire man endorsement Certificate.
Bidder Should submit valid Electrical work shop in Pump Motor Repair trade license in Kunigal TMC limits.
Bidder Should submit valid ESI AND PF CERTIFICATE
Bidder Should submit valid Labor department Registration Certificate
Contractor Registration Certificate -Tenderer in his name should have Electrical Contractor License Registration Certificate enclosed issued by competent authority
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 6.00 Lakhs Unconditional Credit lines/ letters of credit/certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc..

Work Done Certificate- Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, satisfactory completed, at least Similar Nature of work of only Operation and Maintenance of Borewell pump motor work of value not less than Rs.10.00 Lakhs as prime contractor.
